page.running_head: Transactio nova cum liberis Ailconis Howerde & ejus uxore. / Fasti Consulares

main_text.p: † Fœdus civitatis Groning. cum Oest-broecksteranis Columanis & eorum vicinis quibusdam: in quo imprimis de prætoria potestate in judicijs.
Item fœdus ejus-dem cum omnibus Ostergois in quadri-ennium: idque sæpe prorogatum.
Forum majus Groningæ sterni cæptum silicibus.

page.notes: The word "Pacta" in the sixth paragraph is uncertain. The year 1440 is printed as "144" followed by a dot-like mark, which I read as the 0; the mark is uncertain [?]. The years 1444 and 1445 carry a dagger and a double dagger above them, shown in the transcription. Spellings such as "Mauriffinge", "Wigboldes" and "Evert Wigbolts" are copied as printed.
